notes.rasch_jml: Rasch, joint ML (row and column sums matched); conditional on split
notes.fixed_margin: curveball chain (exact row and column sums; = exact conditional Rasch null)
notes.2pl_post: project 2PL: theta_m fixed effects, (log a_i, b_i) normal random effects integrated (marginal ML over questions, 41 x 401 grid); question-matched posterior draws
notes.2pl_prior: project 2PL; (a_i, b_i) from the fitted population law
notes.3pl_post: 3PL with c = 0.25 (P = 0.25 + 0.75 sigma(a_i (theta_m - b_i))), project MML; posterior draws
notes.letter_post: letter-aware know-or-guess: P = pi_m(g) + (1 - pi_m(g)) sigma(a_i (theta_m - b_i)), g = shown gold letter, pi_m = model m's letter preference (4-rotation moment estimate); project MML
notes.ba_a4: Bock-Aitkin 2PL: theta ~ N(0,1) integrated, (a_i, d_i) fixed effects, 0 < a_i <= 4; simulated at ML theta_m (fixed effects given the items)
notes.kg_letter4: know-or-guess fitted on all 4 rotations (composite MML with pi_m letter preference); know once per cell, guess per rotation from pi_m; derived matrix
notes.kg_uniform4: know-or-guess on all 4 rotations with uniform guessing (pi = 0.25 per letter, 3PL-type)
notes.indep4_2pl: 2PL on all 4 rotations with rotations independent given (a_i, b_i) (no shared know state); liberal: cell averages have the smallest variance

representative_draw.rule: draw minimizing sum_j ((lambda_j - median_j) / IQR_j)^2, j = 1..4
